intro.title: New order
intro.text: For a sale taken via WhatsApp, phone or in store. Stock is reserved just like a website order.

customer.title: The customer
customer.text: Name and phone are enough. Without an email, no automatic message is sent.

products.title: Products
products.text: Search and tap a product to add it. Quantity and unit price are editable, for example for a discount. Hidden products can be sold here.

delivery.title: Delivery or pickup
delivery.text: Choose the method and zone. Standard fees apply unless you enter different ones.

payment.title: Channel and payment
payment.text: Record where the sale came from and how it was paid. 'Already paid' issues the invoice right away; otherwise the order stays pending.

total.title: Total
total.text: Subtotal, delivery and amount to collect. Check, then create the order.

intro.title: Customers
intro.text: Your customers grouped by email (or phone), with or without an account: orders, total spent and notes.

list.title: The list
list.text: Tap a customer to open their file: orders, addresses, notes, and a button to create an order for them.

export.title: CSV export
export.text: Downloads the list with the current search and sort.
